відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A refined wool-blend coat in forest green, tailored to a straight cut that falls to mid-calf, color #2E4F36, fabric with a soft drape. A fine-gauge merino turtleneck sweater in cream, fitted through the torso and slightly elongated at the hem, color #F5F5DC, lightweight knit. High-waisted dark denim trousers with a relaxed but structured fit, ankle length just grazing the shoe, color #1C1C1C, sturdy cotton twill. Leather ankle boots with a low block heel in chestnut brown, rounded toe, color #8B4513, smooth grain leather. A minimalist gold bar pendant necklace and small hoop earrings to add subtle polish without bulk. This ensemble works because it layers warmth against the frosty two-degree weather while maintaining an effortless elegance suitable for strolling through the city. The dark denim anchors the look in everyday comfort, while the forest green coat and cream sweater create a sophisticated, monochromatic-inspired palette that feels intentional yet relaxed.
